text: このあいだ　さしあげた　ふえは　やくに　たってるかな？

structure.jp: このあいだ　さしあげた　ふえは
structure.en: the flute I gave you the other day

structure.jp: やくに　たってるかな？
structure.en: I wonder if it is being useful?

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: このあいだ　さしあげた　ふえ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. このあいだ　さしあげた　ふえ = 'the flute I gave you the other day'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder'. たってるかな = 'I wonder if it is being (useful)'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says something is going on now. Here it is shortened to てる, as people do in speech. やくに　たってる = 'is being useful'.
